head: codex/5591-runtime-v3-parity-a-preparation
title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][runtime-v3][parity-a] Make kernel, continuity, and domain ingress live
body:
Closes #5591

Implements canonical signed Runtime v3 ingress, atomic admission closure, deterministic checkpoint/replay/resume, pressure-triggered serialization and graceful shutdown, configured TLS-authenticated local/remote access, Observatory output, and Horust guardian integration without Runtime v2 source or AWS. It also makes the guardian descendant-capture proof deterministic by waiting until the descendant installs its SIGTERM disposition before the parent exits.

Exact final integrated proof passes: 34 focused kernel tests, 187 complete kernel tests with declared ignores, strict all-target/all-feature kernel Clippy, 127 adl-runtime tests, 25 consecutive guardian regressions, the corrected shared coverage-merger contract, formatting, and diff hygiene. Runtime v3 is 12,683 physical source lines, an explicitly reviewed +474 necessary and non-duplicative exception over the pinned #5336 baseline of 12,209; the 20,000 hard ceiling is not exception authority.

Residual risk: the fixed-port Horust SIGTERM process test remains intentionally ignored; dynamic-port pressure and signed terminal paths exercise the shared serialization helper.
